name: Amami Marika
source:
A sports teacher with a winning character.

She started dating  [url=https://vndb.org/c63504]a student[/url] at the time she was still a teacher at his school, then marries with him some time after. She has no experience with men aside with her husband and she's worried about her non-immunity with the other men.

She's being transferred to a public high school, away from her husband and she starts with him a long distance relationship.
